action_and_scope: Use the original temporal/single-turn and activity/adjacent-turn skills at position three. Fit on all 12 registered four-path training windows at sessions 5-8. Evaluate exact two-step question-level F1 with each target dialogue held out. Forward evaluation uses the existing 52 randomized later windows (466 questions); flag every window with even one archived score before numeric freeze. Formal development, LoCoMo test and LongMemEval-S remain separate.
predecision: Reconstruct the actual prefix bank from earlier writes only. Simulate adding dated single turns or adjacent turns from the current source. Keep other writes outside both simulations. Body text of each current single-turn chunk (date and speaker removed) serves as a probe. In each hypothetical bank retrieve five items. Use activity-minus-temporal change in mean capture of the probe's own turn, capture of its adjacent partner when present, survival fraction of old memory entries in the top five over prefix-memory probes, and mean words read by the current probes divided by 100. Older memory text serves as its own probe, measuring survival of the group, not just itself. Empty prefix has zero interference. Use the same frozen Qwen encoder for every string; no future source, question, reference, or generated current write enters the features.
policy: Use a two-stage backward fit on the measured four paths. Within the donor dialogues fit terminal ridge with intercept, standardized four features and slope penalty equal to sample count. Each reachable terminal state contributes one row. The terminal-only supervision is real activity-minus-temporal question-mean F1. The primary version adds the question-mean signed rule-2 effect to this return target. Only full-reference recovery surviving same-skill execution/retrieval probes adds credit. No direct bonus at the root. For each donor window predict terminal probabilities using a model omitting that donor dialogue as well as the outer held dialogue. Evaluate both possible first actions using these probabilities and actual downstream F1. Regress their difference on the root features. Add the predicted advantages divided by 0.05 and clipped to +/-2 to native logits. Equal weight for calibration states, question-weighted F1 for reporting. Fit the deployment model on the six training histories.
controls_and_decision: Compare native, terminal PPO, fixed skills, matched three-context rate-only logit shifts fitted on donor states, and the same two-stage model using terminal F1 alone. Report root-only and continuation-only policy contributions, ordered action paths, mean absolute probability change, read/write token costs and dialogue/type clusters. Use physical randomized path inclusion 1/2 for two-step Horvitz-Thompson F1 as well as paired focal F1. Require at least +.02 versus native and terminal, positive over matched-rate and terminal-supervision-only, positive on at least four histories, positive two-step HT vs native and terminal and at least 90 percent of registered questions before proposing independent development. Purely retrospective scores are diagnostics.
